decisions.reason: After two years the module has had time to prove itself, but as a core-adjacent sensor block with low carrying cost in a broad modular range it is still worth keeping while demand continues to clarify.

This industrial voltage input module remains closely tied to the firm's automation platform and earlier dedicated presentation suggests enough commitment and likely low incremental cost to justify staying in the market.

The relay module fits the established control architecture and is inexpensive to retain as a platform option, even though another year on the market means management now expects clearer evidence of whether demand will deepen.
As a recently launched add-on module the uncertainty around adoption is still high, and because it likely reuses the existing platform the firm should preserve the option rather than exit early.

The remote access service supports the firm's strategic push in wallboxes and energy management, so it should be kept despite somewhat higher ongoing software and support costs while the market potential is still being learned.
